scope: authenticated common-five native streams only; no quant economic candidate and no budget reset

chatgpt.finding: The authenticated implementation explicitly represents close-generated signals as pending T+1 instructions and executes pending signals at a later tradable open. No same-close timing correction is warranted from the inspected common-five ledger.
remaining_limits: native cost/liquidity semantics and corporate-action economic units remain non-normalized

trae.issue: Targets are shifted one session and filled at the current open, but liquidity capacity reads amount_df for that same session; complete daily amount is not known at the open.

binding_probe.method: exact authenticated common-five inputs/source; compare native against amount_df shifted one session and against disabled volume capacities

trae.finding: The amount-cap timing issue exists in source but has zero economic or trade-path effect in this authenticated common-five account, so no corrected return should be manufactured for this case.

dumate.source_finding: buy/sell use get_price(code,date), which returns the same-date close; run_day calculates current-close NAV/risk and may stop/derisk/rebalance before those same-date close fills. Selection factors mostly use history strictly before date, but current-date tradeability and risk state can also consume same-date observations.

decision: Do not rerun ChatGPT or Trae common-five for the identified timing questions. If further comparator normalization is needed, the next fixed correctness experiment should target Dumate same-session-close execution only, preserving its native result separately. No new quant strategy hypothesis is authorized.
